title: canned-schedules self-hosted playground (site.json)
description: An optional file next to the playground's index.html that sets it up for one catalog: the flags every schedule is checked with, the catalog's schedules, and where a valid schedule is proposed. Only this file sets proposal targets, never the page's address.

schema-version.description: Optional. Defaults to the version the page was built with.

name.description: Shown in the page's header, so a team's playground doesn't pass itself off as the public one.

args.description: The flags every schedule is checked with, one argument per array item, as in canned-schedules.args: --require-base, --base, --error-unless-alert-pattern and --set-config-at with --set-config-value. Applied before the page's own and locked, so a schedule valid here is valid in CI.

dir.description: The catalog's folder in the repository, relative to its root. Default: schedules.

names.description: The schedules the catalog already holds, as file names without .canned-schedule.md. A schedule whose name is listed gets the update target, others the create target.

propose.description: URL templates for proposing a valid schedule. Placeholders: {path} (the file's path in the repository), {content} (the schedule in canonical form) and {name} (its name); the page fills them in, URL-encoded.

create.description: A new file, e.g. a forge's new-file page; needs {path} and {content}.

update.description: A change to an existing file; needs {path}. A plain string prefills {content}; with prefill false the page copies the schedule to the clipboard and opens the URL (for forges whose edit page takes no content).

max-length.description: The longest URL the forge takes. Above it the page copies the schedule and opens the URL without {content}. Default: 8000.
